hero.1:
Split the bill.
Pay in crypto.
hero.2: With PayShare, you see who owes what in the group and settle up in seconds, no bank needed.
features.2: Because chasing your friends for three weeks is over: everything gets calculated, everything gets settled.
features.4: You create the group, friends join by QR code, everyone adds their expenses. PayShare does the maths for you.
features.6: Your share goes out in NIM from the app. No bank details to ask for, no transfer to wait on. It all confirms in ~2 seconds.
features.7: Nothing to install, nothing to pay
features.8: No PayShare account, no password, no fees. You sign in with your Nimiq Pay wallet: no personal data collected, and every transaction stays verifiable on the Nimiq blockchain.
story.2: It all happens inside the Nimiq Pay app, no sign-up. Let’s take an example: four friends in Barcelona, and Marie covering the bill.
story.20: Alex creates the group and invites Marie, Lucas and Julie with a QR code. They sign in with their Nimiq Pay wallet: no PayShare account to create.
story.37: Marie pays the bill: 84 NIM. She adds the expense in PayShare and ticks all four participants — the app works out 21 NIM per person.
story.38: 03 You open the app and see your share
story.66: Three expenses or thirty, PayShare recalculates every time: by the end of the trip you owe Marie 42.50 NIM, broken down line by line. Nobody has to pull out a calculator.
story.67: 04 Marie is paid back in two seconds
story.69: Marie has been paid back in the group
story.74: You tap “Settle up”: two seconds later, Marie has her 42.50 NIM. The payment shows as settled for the whole group — no more chasing anyone.
faq.2: Everything you need to know before diving in.
faq.4: Yes, PayShare is 100% free: no subscription, no commission. Only blockchain network fees apply, and on Nimiq they amount to fractions of a cent.
faq.5: Do I need to create an account?+
faq.6: No. Just connect via Nimiq Pay: no email, no password, and no personal data is collected.
faq.7: What if my friends know nothing about crypto?+
faq.8: No problem: they install Nimiq Pay in seconds, join your group by scanning a QR code, and the app handles the rest. No jargon, no setup.
faq.9: Which currency can I use?+
faq.10: NIM, the native currency of the Nimiq blockchain. Amounts are also shown in euros or dollars as a reference, so everyone has a familiar reference.
faq.12: Your funds stay in your Nimiq Pay wallet at all times: PayShare never holds your money and your keys are never exposed. Every transaction is verifiable on the Nimiq blockchain.
cta.3: PayShare does the math for you. All that's left is to pay.
cta.5: Scan to open PayShare on your phone
